title: Wicked: The Life and Times of the Wicked Witch of the West
author: Gregory Maguire
current_text: Wicked: The Life and Times of the Wicked Witch of the West was retained in the tenth-grade honors program at Canandaigua Academy in Ontario County, N.Y., in 2008 despite concerns about sexual content on a few pages.
